action.objective: Capture the loose knight on f4 with the queen, improving material and resolving the pin while keeping king safety and development reasonable.
action.rationale: Qxf4 is the sole commit_ready move: single-candidate verification completed depth 3 (exact score 21), safety.complete true with no mating reply, and tactical_refutation not_found. The PV (d2f4, d7e5, f4e5) recaptures a piece and trades favorably. Nxe5 is the only real structural concern but leaves White solid with d4/f3 pawns and a bishop to develop.
